protocol.overhead: Clock probe10000 stamp pairs before pool,below0.1% warm pass. Compare observed/raw median batch wall for each shape/phase/gap pair;both ratios<=1.10 required for overhead-qualified attribution. protocol.decision: No optimization/model adoption gate.
